name: Ramona Xona Chip Holder 3 well
author: Ramona Optics
part_number: Xona X4 chip holder, 3 slide, 36mm pitch, SBS footprint
notes: The 3 wells of this definition are the 3 chip pockets of the holder, empty: A1 is the leftmost pocket. NOT A CATALOGUE PLATE. This is a Ramona Optics fixture: an SBS-footprint holder that carries 3 Xona XonaChip X4 chips (75.50 x 25.50mm, slide format) with their long axis along the plate's width, so that they can be driven as one plate. Its pockets are 36.00mm apart, twice the MCAM's 18mm micro-camera pitch, so every chip sits under the same camera column. HISTORY: added 2026-10-15/16 (issue #25, PR #26) from the requester's description alone, before any drawing existed, with a provisional 14.35mm height (the ANSI/SLAS default), 25.50 x 75.50mm pockets (the chip without clearance) and a 1.00mm pocket depth. On 2026-11-17 (issue #66) Ramona's CAD replaced all three: height 8.00mm, pockets 25.80 x 75.80mm, depth 6.50mm; pocket centres and pitch are unchanged. CONTROLLING DOCUMENT: Ramona's own dimension drawing 'Xona Chip Holders - 3x and 4x Dimensions' (Tripp Spivey, 2026-11-17, 4 pages: top views of both holders rebuilt from the Onshape model 'Xona Chip-X4 Holder' and a dimension summary), with the matching STL exports 'Xona_Holder_3x36mm.stl' and 'Xona_Holder_4x27mm.stl' (tessellated at 0.005mm chord tolerance from part studios 'Xona Holder 3x36mm' and 'Xona Holder 4x27mm'), shared in #labware-requests on 2026-11-17 (https://ramonaoptics.slack.com/archives/C0BT14F1GTF/p1794930180814739). They are internal Ramona documents, on file at Ramona and not published; the web_reference is Ramona's insert documentation page. The drawing PRINTS the footprint 127.76 x 85.48 x 8.00mm, the pitch, the top-left-corner-to-chip-1 offsets (4x: 23.38 / 42.74mm; 3x: 27.88 / 42.74mm) and the 25.80 x 75.80mm chip pocket, and marks the chamfered corner as A1 at the top left with chip 1 the left-hand pocket. Every other holder number below (skirt and body steps, the chamfer's size, the floor ledge, windows, notches, recesses) is read off the vertex coordinates of the STL, whose origin is the plate centre, so they are the design's nominal values, not measurements of a part. FOOTPRINT AND SKIRT: 127.76 x 85.48mm with 2.00mm corner radii, straight walls from z = 0 to 6.00mm, which is skirt_height. Above that the body is inset 1.60mm on every side (124.56 x 82.28mm, sharp corners) up to the top face at 8.00mm, the plate's height; skirt_thickness is therefore not a separate flange width and is left out. The body has ONE chamfered corner, 4.50 x 4.50mm at 45 degrees, recorded in upper_outline at the top-left (A1) corner; the skirt's outline is the plain rounded rectangle and is not recorded. ORIENTATION, from the drawing: A1 is the chamfered top-left corner and chip 1 the left-hand pocket; in the STL's coordinates that is +y as the plate's top edge (row A) and -x as its left edge. POCKETS: rectangular, 25.80mm along the plate's length x 75.80mm along its width (the 25.50 x 75.50mm Xona X4 chip plus 0.30mm clearance each way), centred at y = 42.74mm and x = 27.88, 63.88 and 99.88mm, 36.0mm apart. Each pocket has a 1.60mm radius relief notch in each end wall near each corner (centred 11.30mm either side of the pocket centre), not recordable in this schema. The pocket floor, the ledge the chip rests on, is at z = 1.50mm, so a pocket is 6.50mm deep from the top face. Through the floor, each pocket has four imaging windows, 17.50 x 9.00mm with 1.00mm corner radii, centred on the pocket's x and at 6.00 and 18.00mm either side of its centre in y - exactly under the four culture units A-D of a centred chip (Xona's 12.00mm unit pitch). Each end of the plate has a finger recess from the outer pocket's end wall outward, 28.00mm along the plate's width with 3.00mm corner radii, floor at z = 1.50mm, also not recordable here. NOT IN THE DRAWING OR THE MODEL, and so not recorded: material, colour, surface finish, tolerances. 'depth' is the pocket depth; the pocket has no closed bottom to image through, so bottom_elevation, bottom_thickness and floor_height are left out. 'diameter' repeats the pocket's shorter side, as for any rectangular well. CORRECTION, 2026-11-17, applied on this branch before merge. The requester (Slack UT35U0XPX, who made the original request) wrote (https://ramonaoptics.slack.com/archives/C0BT14F1GTF/p1794945075529829): 'The STEP files you used are outdated. Rebuild both holders from the new set posted in this thread ... The dimensions PDF is the controlling drawing. A1 is the top-left corner. The 27 mm pitch on the 4-chip holder is intended.' The first version of this branch was built from Onshape STEP AP242 exports of 2026-10-29 ('Xona Holder 3x36mm - Base Plate.step' and 'Xona Holder 4x27mm.step'). The holder was rebuilt from the new set as asked, and NO VALUE CHANGED: every printed number on the new drawing equals the value already in this file, every one of the 306 (3x) and 394 (4x) B-rep vertices of the old STEP export lies within 0.02mm of a vertex of the new STL, both STLs have their horizontal faces at the same four levels (0, 1.50, 6.00 and 8.00mm) and the same extents (127.76 x 85.48 x 8.00mm), and the STL volumes (37,011.7 and 28,497.4mm3) match the drawing's 37,012 and 28,497mm3. What changed is the provenance: the controlling document is now the dimension drawing, and A1 at the chamfered top-left corner, previously an assumption because the STEP model carried no A1 marking, is now printed on the drawing and confirmed by the requester.
